item.text:
**Draft**

In my last post, I shared that I was designing a reusable checklist. I’ve now finished it.

The goal was to make something I could come back to the next time I do the same work. Now I have a starting point for that next pass.

I’m looking forward to seeing which steps I reach for as written and which ones I want to clarify once I’ve used it.

**Private review note**

The publication receipt supports the reference to the prior post, and checklist completion is confirmed. The draft leaves the checklist’s contents and results from using it unspecified.
